writes.condition: One curl child per upstream request; `proxy run` also spawns the caller's command with loopback base-URL variables.
Upstream responses relayed to the loopback client; stderr carries paths, sizes, counts and error summaries, never request or response text.

Append-only proxy-stats.jsonl ledger of per-request token estimates under the gobstopper data dir (or GOBSTOPPER_STATS_FILE); contains sizes, paths and flags, never content. Write failure is non-fatal.

Estimates use four characters per token; provider counts can differ

cli.name: Detect
cli.contract: List configured provider sessions; --all changes age filter.

cli.name: Plan
cli.contract: Evaluate only; configured extensions/models may execute.

cli.name: Apply
cli.contract: Codex/Claude detached copy after admission; Devin direct mutation and released native dispatch refuse before effects.

cli.name: Verify
cli.contract: Structural findings over selected source or canonical Devin export.

cli.name: Undo
cli.contract: Fresh Codex/Claude identity from retained bytes; Devin store restore disabled.

cli.name: Fork
cli.contract: Explicit recovery vault and retained exact candidate precede fresh copy identity.

cli.name: Eval
cli.contract: Offline private replay; optional judge/scorer extensions have separate effects.

cli.name: EvalStudy
cli.contract: Source-bound manifest preparation or offline study/audit; user-selected output manifests are writes.

cli.name: CacheEdits
cli.contract: Proposal/plan output; no provider dispatch by this command.

cli.name: Tune
cli.contract: Recommend configuration; prints selected session ID, does not install config.

cli.name: InstallHooks
cli.contract: Requires --output new private settings bundle; source settings unchanged.

cli.name: UninstallHooks
cli.contract: Requires --output new private removal candidate bundle; source settings unchanged.

cli.name: Hook
cli.contract: Provider callback enumerated separately.

cli.name: Report
cli.contract: Requested normalized report; no model call.

cli.name: Events
cli.contract: Requested event/retention stream includes identities and metrics.

cli.name: Vault
cli.contract: Requested snapshot metadata, optionally exact session scope; --stats reports bounded read-only non-atomic logical-byte and index accounting without object content or reclamation claims.

cli.name: Prune
cli.contract: Dry-run default; --yes permits index replacement and unreachable object deletion.

cli.name: History
cli.contract: Exact provider/store/session scope; archived lookup separate.

cli.name: Show
cli.contract: Snapshot structural summary.

cli.name: Recall
cli.contract: Explicit historical digest fields may contain content; summaries are untrusted historical data.

cli.name: SearchSnapshot
cli.contract: Explicit bounded matching record references.

cli.name: ReadSnapshot
cli.contract: Explicit bounded transcript record content.

cli.name: Diff
cli.contract: Snapshot structural differences.

cli.name: Bench
cli.contract: Private built-in strategy replay with source-bound rows, explicit failure categories and optional configured scorer; no semantic judge calls. Optional CSV output is a new private file and refuses existing targets.

cli.name: Snapshot
cli.contract: Explicit vault publication; prints manifest identity.

cli.name: Mcp
cli.contract: Bounded deterministic inspection; extension strategies refused and external scorers/digests skipped. --allow-transcript-content gates explicit recovery content only.

cli.name: Proxy
cli.contract: serve/run forward loopback client requests through curl, compacting Anthropic Messages and OpenAI Responses bodies over the threshold and forwarding the original bytes on any failure; replay reads one recorded Claude Code or Codex transcript and calls no provider; status reads a local proxy's counters.

cli.name: Watch
cli.contract: Dry-run skips state/event publication. Released native dispatch is guarded even for old auto_compact_closed opt-ins; unresolved operations remain blocked.

cli.name: Auth
cli.contract: Store/delete/status/clipboard/stdin authority; status is a live health check.

cli.name: PolicyCheck
cli.contract: Numeric form pure aside from config; --session reads provider DB/lock observation.

cli.name: Export
cli.contract: Explicit complete canonical transcript content to stdout.

cli.name: Presets
cli.contract: Configured preset metadata.

cli.name: Explain
cli.contract: Static economics explanation, not measured billing.

cli.name: Plugin
cli.contract: check reads manifest/binary hash; inspect invokes trusted provider-read capability.

cli.name: NativeOperations
cli.contract: Read-only metadata for registered native operations; no provider call.

cli.name: NativeReconcile
cli.contract: Exact retained Codex terminal evidence only; append reconciliation without any provider call or invented measurement.

library_scan_scope: Every public or crate-visible fn declaration before inline mod tests in Rust src files. Includes private-module methods/test-only helper declarations conservatively; enclosing profiles cover private implementations, trait methods and external code. An unchanged symbol gaining effects still requires manual review.
